name: Evia Ioannidis
source:
Professor of Archaeology and History at the famous Uteme-Lovond Academy.
Evia is also the Second Mentor for Ciel.
The snake's name is Amartolos, but he is called "Amar" for short.
According to the "Longevity" system, Evia is a top-ranking mtsyr.
